mapper.insert: insert into event_outbox (event_type, routing_key, payload, status, retry_count) values (#{eventType}, #{routingKey}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', 0)
mapper.select: select id, event_type, routing_key, payload, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at from event_outbox where status = 'PENDING' and retry_count < #{maxRetry} order by created_at asc, id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update event_outbox set status = 'SENT' where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update event_outbox set retry_count = retry_count + 1 where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
